image_description: A close-up, eye-level shot of a De Brazza's monkey (a type of guenon) sitting on a wooden post. The monkey has distinctive grey fur with black limbs, a white chest ruff, and a bare face featuring a prominent orange crescent on the forehead and a blueish-white muzzle. It is looking directly at the camera. The background is softly blurred greenery.
